meta.title: 剪一条口播最痛苦的不是剪辑
meta.title_en: Editing a Talking Head: The Pain Isn't the Cutting
meta.topic: AI 剪辑 · 口播粗剪的效率再造

scenes.context: 口播剪辑最痛苦的不是剪辑，而是删重复的话、找气口等重复性工作。
sentences: 剪一条口播最痛苦的不是剪辑。
The most painful part of editing a talking head isn't the cutting.
talking head（口播）
删重复的话、找气口。
Removing repeated lines and finding the breathing spots.
breathing spots（气口）
60% 是重复性工作。
Sixty percent is repetitive work.
repetitive（重复的）
paraphrase: Most of the work is the same boring task again and again.
Finding where the speaker naturally breathes.
scenes.speak: The most painful part of editing a talking head isn't the cutting. It's removing repeated lines and finding the breathing spots. Sixty percent is repetitive work.

scenes.context: AI 用自然语言提示词标注哪些需要画掉，人工确认后再精剪。
sentences: 用自然语言提示词剪重复话和气口。
Use natural-language prompts to flag repeated lines and breaths.
natural-language prompts（自然语言提示词）
AI 不是直接剪，而是标注哪些需要画掉。
The AI doesn't cut directly — it marks what to remove.
mark（标注）
导出 XML 文件到达芬奇。
Export an XML file into DaVinci Resolve.
DaVinci Resolve（达芬奇）
paraphrase: The AI highlights the parts, and you decide what stays.
Send the marked timeline out as an XML file.
scenes.speak: Use natural-language prompts to flag repeated lines and breaths. The AI doesn't cut directly — it marks what to remove. Export an XML file into DaVinci Resolve.

scenes.context: 多机位版本能标注谁在说话，同时实时输出 SRT 字幕，粗剪带字幕且无损。
sentences: 多机位升级：标注谁在说话。
The multi-camera upgrade labels who is speaking.
label（标注）
任意数量的机位输入。
It accepts any number of camera feeds.
camera feeds（机位输入）
实时同步输出 SRT，粗剪带字幕且无损。
It syncs SRT output live — a lossless rough cut with subtitles.
lossless（无损的）
paraphrase: It tags each speaker on the timeline.
You get a cut with subtitles, and nothing is degraded.
scenes.speak: The multi-camera upgrade labels who is speaking. It accepts any number of camera feeds. It syncs SRT output live — a lossless rough cut with subtitles.

scenes.context: 下一步让音轨有声就亮、全部有声切大镜；评价 Headcats 可用度可靠度达标。
sentences: 音轨有声就亮，全部有声切大镜。
Tracks light up when they have audio; cut to the wide shot when all are active.
wide shot（大镜/全景）
可用度、可靠度都达到了能用的水平。
Usability and reliability both reach a workable level.
reliability（可靠度）
这支团队是上海的，非常厉害。
This team is from Shanghai — very impressive.
impressive（厉害）
paraphrase: It's good enough to use in real projects now.
scenes.speak: Tracks light up when they have audio; cut to the wide shot when all are active. Usability and reliability both reach a workable level. This team is from Shanghai — very impressive.

practice: 口播剪辑最痛苦的是什么？
It's the repetitive work, not the cutting itself.
AI 在剪辑里扮演什么角色？
It marks what to remove — it doesn't cut directly.
Export an XML file into DaVinci Resolve for fine cutting.
多机位升级带来了什么？
It labels who is speaking on any number of camera feeds.
pitfalls: 让 AI 直接出成片
AI 只做标注，人做确认与精剪
自动成片会丢失节奏与审美判断。
检查 H.265 是否需要手动配置
编码格式不兼容会导致工程打不开。
AI 数据有延迟，不懂语境梗。
重复交给 AI、创造留给人
创造是 AI 当前的边界。
shifts: AI 接管重复、人做创造
提示词标注提效 10 倍
